description: TASK-G03 live probe of the six G02 atomic Jev questions over a bounded stratified subset of the current corpus (20 C2/IOC + 20 other-malicious + 20 benign), plus a held-out-only re-probe after refining one criterion. Real jev-1.14.0 (requested by name, served-model field recorded), six noul questions over one native-object state, exact payloads and per-category answers saved per case. No production flip; FR-09 legacy isthreat path remains live until G04.
timestamp_provenance: Each run's generated_at is a UTC ISO-8601 instant. It was recovered from the artifact file's birth time (stat -f %B, converted with date -u -r) because the driver did not stamp exports when these two runs were captured; scripts/jev_atomic_probe.py now emits generated_at on every future run. The filename date (2026-11-20) is the local-date label and is intentionally NOT used as the run instant.

method.selection: 20 cases per class (ioc = C2_IOC/REVERSE_SHELL/CREDENTIAL_EXFILTRATION/COVERT_CHANNEL; other_malicious; benign), sorted by eval_case_id from tests/eval/evalsets/blackwall_security.evalset.json
method.split: sha256(eval_case_id).digest()[0] & 1; dev=1, heldout=0. Wording refined from DEV cases only; checked on HELD-OUT cases.
method.refinement: unauthorized_access.criteria.false now names two dev confusers: reading an audit/log table and fetching a declared internal resource for the agent's own task are not unauthorized access.

finding: The refinement reduced benign false holds on HELD-OUT cases from 1/11 (clear-high) to 0/11 and lowered the benign unauthorized_access mean 0.216 -> 0.170, with malicious detection unchanged (IOC 8/8 clear-high, other malicious 6/7). The wording hypothesis is supported on this held-out check; the full calibration hypothesis is still G04's. IMPORTANT: no case in any class scored clear-low under the atomic max at the 0.08 lower edge — all benign cases escalate to Tier-2 — so the band MUST be re-validated (F10 sweep on Track G runs) before any production flip.
caveats: Single model release (jev-1.14.0), bounded sample (60 cases; 26 held-out), one refinement iteration.
Probe records Tier-1 signals only, not full-firewall verdicts; no clear-low means high Tier-2 load, not a security bypass.
No production change: _build_payload still uses the legacy isthreat question until G04's held-out gate passes.
Refined wording is in the shared jev_questions.json used by both Python and the dev .mjs helper (parity test).
